fusions.name: Spore Puff
fusions.desc: Puffs spores from your skin, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles, and you regain 4 health.

fusions.name: Rooting into the Weak
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Sends a thread of rot into it from up to 6 tiles away that deals 24 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Moss Bed
fusions.desc: Grows a bed of moss where you lie still. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Grown Overnight
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
